summary.text: Joe Sosnowski, a Republican, has represented Illinois's 69th House District since January 2011.

paragraphs.text: According to the General Assembly biography, he was born in Hanover Park, graduated from West Chicago High School in 1995, and earned a B.A. in English from Northern Illinois University in 1999.
He served as a DeKalb alderman from 1999 to 2003 and a Rockford alderman from 2005 to 2010.
The biography also lists him as a former director of institutional advancement at Rockford Christian Schools and a licensed real estate salesperson.
